text: The ___ Theorem states that if f is continuous on [a,b] and differentiable on (a,b), then there is a point c in (a,b) with f'(c) = (f(b)-f(a))/(b-a).
explanation: This is the Mean Value Theorem: geometrically, some tangent line is parallel to the secant joining the endpoints. It follows from Rolle's theorem and underlies error estimates and monotonicity tests.
